//: Run against the REAL production image, not `staticDistDir`.
Half of what blocks a 100 here is response headers -- CSP, HSTS, nosniff,
COOP, and gzip -- and none of those exist in a static file server. Auditing
`dist/` would score a bundle nobody is served and would have to switch off
the very audits this work was done to pass. `scripts/lhci.sh` builds
Dockerfile.prod and points this at it.
Performance sits at 0.99, not 1.0. It is a simulated-throttling score and it
is not stable to the point: a run lands 99 for reasons unrelated to the
commit. The other three are deterministic, so a regression in them is always
real -- which is what keeps a red build worth reading.
